resources.string: Call settings

After explicit launch, navigates only within ChatGPT and attempts one call-button click for your selected Dot, then checks a configured call-screen marker. Stops within 30 seconds. Reads screen labels, but does not store chat content, record audio, send messages, or use the internet. Configure and verify labels before enabling. If enabled in advanced setup, only the initial Bixby window can receive one Back action after explicit launch; other apps are never dismissed.

Unlock the phone, then run your Samsung routine to start a Dot call in ChatGPT. Accessibility service access is required.\n\nThe app reads ChatGPT screens and attempts one call within 30 seconds. The optional Bixby handoff sends Back once to its initial window. Settings stay on this device; no recording, chat logs, internet permission or backups. The floating shortcut is unnecessary.
